groups.sentence: Instructors co-create the course's AI policy, norms or guidelines with their students.
Instructors discuss appropriate AI use with students or co-design AI-related work, as shown in policy examples and resources.
Instructors hold an initial class discussion with students on responsible AI use, and encourage students to propose guidelines.
The class co-creates a class agreement on AI use with students early in the semester.
Involving students in policy development builds understanding, goodwill, trust and buy-in.
